name: KALIUM CYANATUM
key_symptoms: Cough prevents sleep; respiration weak; cannot take deep breath.
guiding_symptoms: Cough prevents sleep; respiration weak; cannot take deep breath.
head_symptoms: Severe neuralgia in temporal region, recurring daily at same hour. Pain in orbital and supra-maxillary region, with screaming and loss of consciousness.
respiratory_symptoms: Cough prevents sleep; respiration weak; cannot take deep breath.
